newsitem.title: SYRIA: Syria confirms it sold Algeria durum wheat in July.
newsitem.headline: Syria confirms it sold Algeria durum wheat in July.

text.p: Syria's General Establishment for Cereal Processing and Trade (GECPT) last month sold Algeria 150,000 tonnes of hard amber durum wheat for September/August delivery, a GECPT official told Reuters on Wednesday.
He did not reveal the price but said the deal was sealed in late July after a tender issued by Algeria.
European grain traders said on Tuesday Algeria was negotiating for a further 150,000 tonnes of optional-origin durum wheat for September and October.
The most likely candidates to supply the durum in a tender included Syria and Canada, they said.
